text: The final chapter starts here — what is Lakeflow, actually?

Autoloader becomes Lakeflow Connect. The for each batch and merge pipeline logic becomes Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines. Jobs and chained tasks become Lakeflow Jobs. Nothing brand new here — this course's own material, unified under one real product name.

Worth knowing: Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines was previously called Delta Live Tables, or D-L-T. Real, current documentation and existing production code still reference D-L-T by that older name — and at dlt dot table, in Lesson 51, is the actual decorator you'll write.

This chapter covers Lakeflow Connect properly, then Declarative Pipelines in depth, then Lakeflow Jobs and monitoring, a comparison to the Data Factory course, and finally — Lesson 57, this entire course's own finale, not just this chapter's.
A real name for what you already built. Next lesson: Lakeflow Connect, ingestion, properly.
